Day 1: Land in Milan at 07:00 am. Explore the city and stay then night
Day 2: Take a morning train to Venezia Santa Lucia. Explore the city. Stay the night
Day 3: Take a morning train to Bologna. Visit the university. Catch up with friends. Stay the night
Day 4-5-6: Take a train to Florence. Explore the city for 3 days. Maybe one of the days go to Pisa to see the tower. (Anything else I can add?)
Day 7: take a train to Rome and then a flight to Bari. Explore Bari
Day 8: Explore Monopoli/Ostuni
Day 9: Fly back to Rome
Day 10-11-12: Explore Rome and then fly back to India from Rome.
